lead: Use every time you are about to write or rewrite prose a human will read (emails, docs, READMEs, reports, posts, summaries, chat replies), and whenever the person says draft, write up, humanize, de-AI, make it sound like me, or says text sounds like AI: writes in their own voice, free of AI tells.

audit.cue: check existing text for AI tells, optionally rewrite it

calibrate.cue: build or rebuild the voice profile from samples

review.cue: show, prune, or undo what the learning loop changed
